Definition: to melt, i.e. literally (to soften, flow down, disappear), or figuratively (to fear, faint)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to melt, cause to melt; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to melt, faint; 1a2) to cause to melt; 1b) (Niphal) to melt away; 1c) (Polel) to soften, dissolve, dissipate; 1d) (Hithpolel) to melt, flow
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
